authority: OWNER-BATTERY-STUDY-SHEET-01 (owner, 2026-10-07: "team proposes all rows, I approve it for testing"); never production

rationale.challenge_version: The battery construction contract's registered version.
rationale.gpu_model: The owner moved the study from the A40, which RunPod could not allocate, to the RTX 4090 on verified Vast hosts (2026-10-08, OWNER-BATTERY-STUDY-4090-01). It is a new device class; its curves are never pooled with another class's.
rationale.image_digest: Unset until worker-images-v3 is released: v2's PyTorch GPU image fails every FNO rebuild (#826). The study runs on released digests only.
rationale.spend_ceiling: Grant TRAINING-BUDGET-GRANT-BATTERY-STUDY-02: 65 RTX 4090 pod-hours at USD 0.48 an hour (USD 31.20: 682 Phase A-G rebuilds at 120 s, and 1,800 Level 0 plus 180 Level 1-4 Phase H rebuilds at 60 s, is 55.7 h, plus 15% overhead, rounded up) and a 3 h A100-80 memory leg at USD 1.20 an hour (USD 3.60); generation on the AX42 costs nothing. Re-estimated after Phase A (runbook step 6).
rationale.study_seed_root: Unset until the producer creates the study seed root on the VM and records its commitment (#738); it never leaves the VM.
rationale.study_contract_ranges: About 2-4 times today's caps on each cost-driving setting, so plateaus can show above the current cap without going far past it.
rationale.rebuild_time_target: Five minutes, the spec's own R8 example (288 worst-case rebuilds per GPU-day).
rationale.memory_ceiling: 20 GiB of the 4090's 24 GB, the A40's 40-of-48 headroom rule: room for the CUDA context, cuFFT plans and allocator slack. Cells over it run on the A100-80 leg only.
rationale.study_time_limit: Six times the time target, above R7's three times the costliest prediction, so no study rebuild is cut short by the limit.
rationale.seeds_per_setting: The spec's minimum of three; Phase D uses five by the spec.
rationale.study_recipes: The defaults of every rebuildable battery family: knn, mlp, deeponet and fno.
rationale.generation_ceiling: Eight times the 400-case TRAIN set, the top of the template's default ladder.
rationale.minimum_panel_size: At least six configurations per rebuildable family, so Phase H's screen is judged on a spread of recipes.
rationale.target_utilization: Half load, so arrivals rarely queue behind a rebuild.
rationale.expected_participation: A quarter of the 256 worst case per tempo, beside the worst case R11 always reports.
rationale.study_eval_size: 200 cases, the size of battery's public PRACTICE set and its tuning set v2.
rationale.confirmation_size: 120 cases, the size of battery's Graphite confirmation set (graphite-confirmation-v1).
